ReleaseNotes: This release focuses on application polish, diagnostics, update management, and usability improvements.
Added a full-featured Logs Viewer with searching, filtering, refresh, archive management, and improved toolbar controls.
Added manual update checking from the About page with clear checking, up-to-date, update-available, and error states.
Added configurable automatic update checking, including enable/disable control and check frequency.
Added configurable automatic update checking, including enable/disable control and check frequency.
Added an update-available tray icon that remains visible regardless of VM state changes until the update is installed.
Added a tray notification when a new application update is detected.
Redesigned and expanded the About page with Manager, Updater, VirtualBox, and COM status information.
Added detailed application information including platform, .NET runtime, architecture, build type, install location, and data location.
Added quick access to the application's data folder directly from the About page.
Improved the Settings page layout and toolbar/button styling with modern vector icons and hover states.
Moved application settings to %LOCALAPPDATA%\VBoxTrayManager\Config with automatic migration of existing settings.
Improved general UI consistency, iconography, spacing, and visual polish throughout the application.
Added developer and copyright information to the About page.
Existing settings are migrated automatically to the new configuration location. No manual configuration changes should be required.
